common.privacy.title: Quote privacy
common.privacy.purpose: Legado asks for your name, email and event details to prepare and respond to your request. Your phone number is optional. Give only headcounts for dietary needs, without guests’ names or diagnoses.
common.privacy.storage: Your draft is stored in this tab so you can return to it. Downloading a PDF creates a copy on your device. Preparing an email opens your email app and you decide whether to send it. If direct submission is available, your request goes to Legado’s configured receiving service.
common.privacy.rights: You can request access, correction or deletion and, where applicable, objection, portability or blocking. Legado still needs to confirm the controller, the contact channel for requests and retention periods before using real data in the admin panel.
